name: My Femboy Roommate
source: In My Femboy Roommate, you've just moved to a new city and are looking for a quiet place to launch your indie dev career. You share an apartment with your new roommate, Robin. He is a shy but cute livestreamer who reveals himself to be a Femboy. Do you have what it takes to form a genuine relationship with your new Femboy roommate?
translation: 在《My Femboy Roommate》中，你刚刚搬到一个新城市，正在寻找一个安静的地方来开启你的独立开发生涯。你与新室友罗宾合住一间公寓。他是一位害羞但可爱的直播主，透露自己是一名Femboy。你有能力与新的Femboy室友建立真诚的关系吗？
